title: Suno joins the audio API
summary:
Three alpha models joined the lineup for music, text, and images, while Enter got better at keeping GitHub accounts straight.

Added alpha Suno v5 music generation through `/v1/audio/speech` using model `suno`, with a Suno v4.5 fallback. Music responses also use MP4 metadata for duration when available.

The same model update added alpha Step 3.5 Flash for text generation and FLUX.2 Dev for images.

Enter now updates stored usernames when GitHub accounts are renamed. It also checks account bans during session and API-key authentication and provides a clearer account-deactivation error page.

highlights.text: Generate music through `/v1/audio/speech` with the alpha `suno` model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=suno).
